title: Loudness make-up in the page with the wasm renderer
description:
Reuse rw_master_gain and the render worker (web/src/audio/render-worker.ts) to measure the master make-up gain before writing the set, when the option is on. Pass the gain into rw_export_daw_set's options. Progress reported as a render phase before the fetch phase.

Verification: the parity test's loudness case matches the CLI's measured gain within 0.1 dB.
